name: Sulfonmethane
summary: Sulfonmethane (sulfonomethane, sulfonal, acetone diethyl sulfone) is a chemical compound first synthesized by Eugen Baumann in 1888 and introduced as a hypnotic drug by Alfred Kast later on, but now superseded by newer and safer sedatives. Its appearance is either in colorless crystalline or powdered form. In United States, it is scheduled as a Schedule III drug in the Controlled Substances Act.

pharmacology.en: It depresses the central nervous system, causing drowsiness and sleep. Exactly how it works is not well understood.
pharmacology.zh: 它會抑制中樞神經系統，使人嗜睡入眠，但確切的作用機制並不清楚。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它会抑制中枢神经系统，使人嗜睡入眠，但确切的作用机制并不清楚。

uses.en: It was once used as a sleeping drug and sedative but has long been replaced by newer medicines.
uses.zh: 它曾作為安眠藥與鎮靜劑使用，但早已被較新的藥物取代。
uses.zhHans: 它曾作为安眠药与镇静剂使用，但早已被较新的药物取代。

sideEffects.en: It builds up in the body with repeated use, causing lasting drowsiness, unsteadiness and confusion. Long-term use was linked to porphyria, which can turn urine dark red, and overdose could be fatal.
sideEffects.zh: 反覆使用會使它在體內累積，造成持續的嗜睡、步態不穩與意識混亂。長期使用與紫質症有關，這種疾病可能使尿液變成深紅色，而過量可能致命。
sideEffects.zhHans: 反复使用会使它在体内累积，造成持续的嗜睡、步态不稳与意识混乱。长期使用与紫质症有关，这种疾病可能使尿液变成深红色，而过量可能致命。

fact.en: Sulfonal was first made by the German chemist Eugen Baumann in 1888 and introduced as a sleeping drug by Alfred Kast. It was one of the first synthetic hypnotics, decades before the barbiturates became common.
fact.zh: Sulfonal在1888年由德國化學家歐根．鮑曼首次合成，並由阿爾弗雷德．卡斯特引入作為安眠藥。它是最早的合成催眠藥之一，比巴比妥類普及早了數十年。
fact.zhHans: Sulfonal在1888年由德国化学家欧根．鲍曼首次合成，并由阿尔弗雷德．卡斯特引入作为安眠药。它是最早的合成催眠药之一，比巴比妥类普及早了数十年。
